name: Track-A tau-bench baseline (AgentRx reproduction)
license: AgentRx code MIT (LICENSE.txt); tau-bench data under its upstream license

pipeline_config.producer: run.py (ir -> static -> dynamic -> check -> judge -> report)
pipeline_config.command: python run.py data/tau_retail/tau_dataset_failed.json --domain tau --endpoint copilot --ground-truth data/ground_truth/tau_ground_truth.json --dynamic-mode oneshot --run-name tau_sol_rN
pipeline_config.model: gpt-6.1-sol (env AGENT_VERIFY_COPILOT_MODEL; telemetry logs the endpoint as 'copilot-cli')
pipeline_config.note: The run artifacts are the versioned LLM output. Reproducing the NUMBER needs only the scorer + these artifacts (stdlib, no credentials). Re-running the pipeline that produced them needs credentials and is LLM-nondeterministic by design.

metric.step_accuracy: fraction where predicted critical-step index == ground-truth root-cause step
metric.category_accuracy: fraction where predicted failure category == ground-truth root-cause category (10-cat taxonomy)

paper_comparison.category: ~31 vs paper one-shot +Vio 41.9 +/- 2.4 — gap is a model/annotator boundary disagreement (cat 6 Underspecified -> cat 1 Instruction Adherence)
